policy: Every photo on this site is a real photograph of Tayo and Kemi Akinyemi, taken from the live Zoe Life Squarespace site or provided by Cozy Digital / the client. No Unsplash, Pexels, generated pastor-couple stock, or interchangeable stock people.

zoe-life-wordmark.png.source: Derived from zoe-life-wordmark.jpg by removing the cream box so the banner sits on the page background.

zoe-life-wordmark.jpg.use: Source file for the transparent banner. Not used in the live header.
zoe-life-wordmark.jpg.source: Recreated from the client-supplied banner-style logo (gold wordmark, green leaf in O).

zoe-life-mark.png.source: Live Squarespace CDN, circular mark used on zoelifehub.com.
